mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_requirement ( source_recruitment_request_id, position_org_name, vacancy_count, technical_platform, recruit_level, recruit_count, position_responsibility, recruit_requirement, acceptance_status, dispatch_supplier_count, received_supplier_count, demand_status, create_time, create_user_id, create_user_name, update_time, update_user_id, update_user_name ) VALUES ( #{sourceRecruitmentRequestId}, #{positionOrgName}, #{vacancyCount}, #{technicalPlatform}, #{recruitLevel}, #{recruitCount}, #{positionResponsibility}, #{recruitRequirement}, #{acceptanceStatus}, #{dispatchSupplierCount}, #{receivedSupplierCount}, #{demandStatus}, #{createTime}, #{createUserId}, #{createUserName}, #{updateTime}, #{updateUserId}, #{updateUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_requirement SET position_org_name = #{positionOrgName}, vacancy_count = #{vacancyCount}, technical_platform = #{technicalPlatform}, recruit_level = #{recruitLevel}, recruit_count = #{recruitCount}, position_responsibility = #{positionResponsibility}, recruit_requirement = #{recruitRequirement}, acceptance_status = #{acceptanceStatus}, dispatch_supplier_count = #{dispatchSupplierCount}, received_supplier_count = #{receivedSupplierCount}, demand_status = #{demandStatus}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} WHERE demand_id = #{demandId}
